Method of Attack: Exploitation of a zero-day vulnerability in the MOVEit file transfer application
Impacted Systems: AutoZone systems supporting the MOVEit application
Attack Vector: Zero-day vulnerability exploitation in MOVEit file transfer software
Indicators of Compromise: Data breach involving exfiltration of data of 184,995 people

Leaked dataset of approximately 1.1GB containing employee names, email addresses, parts supply details, tax information, payroll documents, Oracle database files, store data, production and sales information
Clop ransomware gang published stolen data on July 7, 2023
